purpose: Targeted expansion after a future locked 3000 membership exists. This policy does not authorise expansion now.
preconditionsBeforeAnyExpansion: This coverage/shard blueprint accepted by Codex/human review
Separate authorisation for selection/generation of the 3000
Membership freeze with uniqueness and quota compliance reports
Coverage-gap report produced against this schema
No programme PASS claimed merely because 3000 exists
expansionPrinciples: Expand to close measured blocking/major gaps, not to inflate headcount.
Prefer new semantic uniqueness over remixing existing skeletons.
Keep denominator separation from first census, diverse-second, 18-core, and sealed holdouts.
Do not pretend expansion equals universal criminal coverage.

priorityOrder.focus: Blocking quota or coupling deficits from the coverage-gap report
priorityOrder.action: Add minimum unique matters to close blocking cells only

priorityOrder.focus: Under-represented hard cells still within claim

examples: Increase pdf planned_exercise where storage allows

priorityOrder.action: Only after specialist design gates; enter as separately labelled specialist corpora, not silent merges into the 3000 claim

batchSizing.note: Expansion beyond 3000 must either amend shard policy expressly or create S13+ under the same envelope rules.

antiInflationGuards: Every expansion candidate must pass prohibited-duplicate rules
Gap-linked justification required on each added matter
No equal padding across families to make charts look even
stopConditions: L1 identity or complete fingerprint duplicate
Combined semantic signature duplicate after normalisation
Document/evidence/combined dominance cap breach by stratum
Attempt to close gaps by relabelling without truth support
Any request to claim programme PASS from expansion alone
